facts.fact: Lucan 与 Micah 带 Maple 登上安伯克雷斯特山。
facts.anchor: Mount Embercrest rises before us, its jagged peaks disappearing into a veil of clouds.

facts.fact: 行装是两人从 Micah 家准备的水与食物。
facts.anchor: filled with water canteens and food we grabbed from Micah’s cottage

facts.fact: Micah 沿途拦住 Maple 乱吃植物。
facts.anchor: “Careful,” he murmurs, crouching beside her. “Don’t eat that.”

facts.fact: Micah 仍牵着绳，担心 Maple 融不进龙群。
facts.anchor: He sighs. “I just want to make sure she’s safe until we know she’s settled with the other dragons.”

facts.fact: Lucan 安慰他龙群不会排斥 Maple。
facts.anchor: “But Dragons are very social creatures, Micah. You know this better than anyone. They’ll love her.”

facts.fact: 爬山途中 Micah 体力下降，停下来休息。
两人分吃橙子，Lucan 心猿意马。
山顶风寒，Lucan 把自己的围巾让给 Micah。
facts.anchor: I pull it free and hold it out to him.

facts.fact: Lucan 亲手替 Micah 围好围巾。
facts.anchor: Before he can protest again, I step closer and drape the scarf around his shoulders.
Together, we continue up the mountain, following Maple through the falling snow.
